Henshaw's Santa Cruz (Awaswas) list, recorded 26-29 Sept 1888 (p. 89), is printed as the 'Santa Cruz' column of the Costanoan table pp. [160] ff; the Phonetic Key (unnumbered page before the vocabularies, pdf p. 12) says 'The accented syllable of every word marked by an acute accent.. [In the original, the acute accent marking the syllabic stress is placed sometimes over the letter and sometimes at the end of the syllable.]' So the volume contains per-word stress marks (e.g. u-li' 'head', ha'-kas 'throat', ra-na'-i 'neck', a-la'-cu 'infant', kor'-o 'foot') but no analysis or s…
